scope: Bounded commissioning validation of checksum-verified Binance daily metrics archives against the immutable connected read-only native-5m tail. No paper fill, performance, model change, order/account endpoint, source substitution, or gate promotion.

timestamp_semantic_evidence.conclusion: For the two open-interest archive fields, archive create_time + 5 minutes uniquely matches the connected endpoint timestamp across all 283 rows and both archive days. This does not by itself authorize applying the same semantic to every ratio family.

ratio_contract_evidence.tested_contract: absolute archive/live delta <= half one least-significant decimal unit published by the connected endpoint
ratio_contract_evidence.conclusion: The generic precision-only explanation is rejected. Ratio families require separate source-semantic investigation before any archive/live normalization can be promoted. The taker family shows especially large disagreement under the OI +5-minute alignment, so it must not be coerced by rounding tolerance.

next_safe_step: Boundedly diagnose timestamp/value semantics separately for each ratio family, especially taker, against the same immutable connected tail and checksum-verified archives. Do not alter raw values, relax tolerance, promote the generic +5-minute mapping to all metrics, or run paper fills until that source contract is evidence-backed.
